create.invalid_400: serializer.errors (400); includes read-only writes (workspace/owner) and validate() error bodies from fx-ser-sticky
create.rule: workspace = Workspace.get(slug) (DoesNotExist -> 404 mapping); serializer = StickySerializer(data); valid -> save(workspace_id, owner_id); 201 serializer.data

destroy.rule: get_object() (404 mapping when missing/other-owner); sticky.delete() (hard delete via instance .delete(); soft-delete manager NOT consulted on instance delete -> row removed); 204

list.rule: query = query_params.get('query', False); qs = get_queryset().order_by('-created_at'); if query: filter(description_stripped__icontains); paginate(default_per_page=20, on_results=many-serialize)

partial_update.rule: get_object(); StickySerializer(sticky, data, partial=True); valid -> save() (recomputes description_stripped, keeps sort_order); 200 serializer.data

retrieve.rule: get_object() (scoped by get_queryset: workspace slug + owner); 200 StickySerializer(sticky).data

bugs: Destroy hard-deletes (views/sticky.py:112 instance .delete()) while the model inherits SoftDeleteModel: the row is REMOVED, not tombstoned (contrast asset soft-deletes). Port as-is.
Create looks up Workspace WITHOUT soft-delete awareness beyond the default manager (Workspace.objects.get(slug) — default manager; behaviour depends on Workspace's own manager). Port as-is.
pagination: BasePaginator.paginate default_per_page=20 (views/sticky.py:72-77); envelope shape per paginator contract (see app_issues list_pages golden for the 12-key envelope)
permission: WorkspaceUserPermission on every action (views/sticky.py:28; goldens in fx-perm)
